articles.title: Grafton Group (LSE:GFTU) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain On Cash Flow

For anyone tracking the stock, the issue is no longer just recent returns, but how those cash flows stack up against today's price. articles.title: Grafton Group PLC's Dividend Analysis
articles.summary: Grafton Group PLC (GROUF) recently announced a total dividend of $0.15 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-10. For value investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical deadline: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payout. As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
